name: sn109
description: SN109 Finsight — Finsight is a decentralized personal investment intelligence. Turn the financial news, filings, and market data that touch an investor's holdings into scored, portfolio-aware signals. Bittensor powers finsight.tech, a Canada-first portfolio platform with native TFSA/RRSP logic, CRA-ready cost-basis tracking, and superficial-loss awareness. Built for Canadians by Canadians. Daily snapshot + live reads (price, news, trades, candles, validators) from the local bt index.
